title: Staff Nurse
must_have: 1+ years of experience in clinical nursing
text:
Staff Nurse
Shanti Multispeciality Hospital | Full-time | Hybrid, India

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are hiring a staff nurse to join our clinical nursing team. You will work with cross-functional partners and own outcomes end to end.

MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS:
- Infection Control
- Patient Education
- Patient Assessment
- Electronic Health Records
- IV Therapy
- 1+ years of experience in clinical nursing

NICE-TO-HAVE:
- ICU Care
- Basic Life Support
- Vital Signs Monitoring
- Medication Administration

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Drive outpatient department flow with measurable outcomes.
- Drive post-operative ward coordination with measurable outcomes.
- Drive medical-surgical unit handover with measurable outcomes.
